title: Message/set burnOnRead burns sender's own copy
description: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs ~L1646-1658: when a patch sets readAt, pre_patch_burn_on_read checks only burn_on_read, not sender_id != account_id, so an owner marking their own sent burnOnRead message read hard-deletes it via read_and_burn_message. Spec draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L660: 'Applies only to the receiving mailbox; the sender's own copy is not affected.' Found during review fix of JMAP-y3f2.6 (sweep_expired fixed there).
